name: White Bean Quesadillas with Avocado-Jalapeño Salsa

instructions.primary_message: Fill a small saucepan halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ jalapeño pepper
1 avocado
½ lime
½ small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and quarter onion. Peel garlic.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium yellow onion
1 clove garlic

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the saucepan is boiling, add jalapeño, onion, and garlic. Cook until slightly tender, about 5 minutes, then drain and rinse under cold water to cool. (Reserve ¼-cup cooking water.)
Meanwhile, halve and pit avocado; using a spoon, scoop out the flesh and place in a blender.
Juice lime into the blender, then add spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ tsp cumin, ground
¼ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: When the blanched veggies are completely cool, add to the blender. Blend on high, adding reserved cooking water, 1 tablespoon at a time, if needed, to reach a smooth consistency, 1-2 minutes. Transfer avocado salsa to a small bowl.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the avocado salsa, stir to combine, and set aside.
Drain and rinse beans, place in a medium bowl, and pat dry with paper towels. Add cheese, chili powder, and salt; stir to combine the filling.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (15 oz) can cannellini (white kidney) beans
2 cups shredded cheese, Mexican blend
1 tsp chili powder
⅛ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To assemble the quesadillas, lay tortillas on a flat surface and divide filling between them, arranging on one half of each tortilla. Fold in half to close.
Preheat a large skillet over medium heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add half of the oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Place two of the assembled quesadillas in the skillet and cook, flipping halfway through, until golden on both sides and cheese is melted, 5-6 minutes. Remove to a cutting board. (Repeat with remaining oil and quesadillas.)
Cut each quesadilla into three wedges and arrange on a serving platter; serve with salsa on the side. Enjoy!
